description: Shared technical module for the existing mixed-purpose LiteGraph utility file: media-node detection, widget lookup and callbacks, slot migration, and graph-item presentation. This records the current compatibility module and its debt; it does not assert that these concerns should remain together.

characterizationScenarios.name: Legacy graph utility adapters preserves its existing behavior

compatibilityPromises: Inventory preserves existing exports and behavior without granting cross-module permissions. This record describes current responsibilities, not a proposed extraction interface.
